name: Iron and Wax
gmNotes: Tutorial Side Mission for iron vulnerability, the Iron ability, fail-forward infiltration, domestic Fey labour, Brownie professional status, and Mission Trackers. It may be completed before or after Milk and Cream. The player should not yet learn that Coinín's supplies serve Takelings and clones.
briefing: Coinín's friend Buaic cannot enter the beekeeper's workshop where he works by night. A new apprentice has scattered and hidden iron nails to ward off Fairies. Get Buaic safely back to his candles and earn the honey needed for Coinín's bargain.
objective: Remove the iron from Buaic's workshop, secure two méisrin of honey, and bring Grannie the candle he gives you.
debriefing: Buaic is back among his candles, Grannie has a wax light fit for a feast day, and Coinín has his honey. If the milk and cream are also delivered, your side of the bargain is complete.

storyBeats.title: A Brownie in Need
storyBeats.events: At the Hollow Tree, Coinín directs the team to his friend Buaic, a Brownie candle maker whose payment includes the honey still owed under the silence bargain. He makes helping Buaic sound charitable while carefully preserving his own interest in the result. His concealed Fairy Door offers a route to the woods west of Trí Mhuilinn, closer to the beekeeper's workshop.
storyBeats.objective: Hear Coinín's proposal for obtaining the honey.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Do not state that Coinín wants the honey for a supply chain. Let the player continue to believe he may want it for himself. This is assistance toward an existing obligation, not a new automatic Grace charge. Let the team use the Fairy Door to the Hidden Fairy Door in the western woods or take another sensible route. The portal bypasses travel only; it does not solve Buaic's problem or the workshop infiltration.

storyBeats.title: The Finest Candles in the Region
storyBeats.events: Buaic waits outside the widowed beekeeper's work shed, furious at being reduced to helplessness. A new apprentice, unaware that the Brownie's labour keeps the workshop running, has scattered nails across the floor and hidden more among tools, shelves, wax, and thresholds. Buaic insists that he is a master candle maker, not a grateful little spirit awaiting rescue.
storyBeats.objective: Learn why Buaic cannot enter his workplace.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Unlock Brownie Common Knowledge. Play Buaic's professional pride seriously. He is physically endangered by iron and cannot simply follow the team inside. Let the player inspect, plan, and ask him technical questions without revealing the laboratory supply chain.

storyBeats.title: Nails in the Dark
storyBeats.events: The team enters the dark workshop and searches for visible and concealed nails without waking the household or meeting the apprentice. Iron ability, smithcraft, careful observation, and improvised collection methods can all help. Set Workshop cleared of iron to 1 only when the room is genuinely safe for Buaic.
storyBeats.objective: Find and remove every piece of iron that bars Buaic's return.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Do not invent an exact nail count; the unique tracker represents complete clearance. Use a small number of meaningful checks rather than one roll per nail. Failure may cause noise, a cut, suspicion, a missed cache Buaic detects from outside, or a hurried confrontation, but it must lead to another approach rather than block completion.

storyBeats.title: Honey and a Candle
storyBeats.events: Once the iron is gone, Buaic returns to his bench and demonstrates why he calls his candles the finest in the region. From the honey left under his arrangement, he gives the team two méisrin for Coinín. He also gives the player a wax candle ‘for your grandmother’ and firmly tells him not to offer thanks. Set the honey tracker to 2 and the wax-candle tracker to 1.
storyBeats.objective: Restore Buaic's work and receive the promised payment.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Unlock Brownie Deep Lore after the exchange. Explain only through behaviour that direct gifts, formal thanks, or gratitude-settlement can alter a Brownie's contract; do not reveal the full lab/milk-hub truth. If the player thanks him anyway, apply the existing Grace/Bargain rules and let Buaic react as a professional whose carefully framed exchange has been spoiled, without erasing the Mission reward.

storyBeats.title: The Last Measures
storyBeats.events: The team brings two méisrin of honey back to Coinín's Hollow Tree. He acknowledges delivery. If the cream and milk have also been delivered, the accepting party's promised goods are now complete; Coinín remains bound not to tell Morrigan that he saw them together.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Keep the honey tracker at target as historical objective progress. Update Coinín's Silence with the delivery. Resolve the accepting party's combined obligation only when all three quantities have been delivered. Do not resolve Coinín's ongoing nondisclosure obligation.

storyBeats.title: Waxlight
storyBeats.events: The player gives Grannie the candle. She is delighted by the luxury: ‘A wax candle, no less? Fierce kind Brownie, that one! I do hope he becomes a Hob some day.’ The remark may make little sense to the player yet.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Let the scene close warmly. Grannie knows more about Brownie and Hob status than she explains. Do not turn her remark into an immediate lecture unless the player asks; if asked, answer at the currently unlocked Deep Lore level.

description: A proud Brownie has been driven from his candle workshop by a floor full of iron nails. Clear the hidden danger, restore his night's work, and the honey owed to Coinín may finally be within reach.
completionEffects: Record the two méisrin of honey as delivered under Coinín's Silence. If Milk and Cream has already delivered all cream and milk, mark the accepting party's joint goods obligation resolved; otherwise leave it unresolved. Coinín's nondisclosure obligation remains active. Preserve the candle tracker at target as history after Grannie receives it. Do not advance the moon phase.
